title: NoNausea
description: This data pack removes nausea, this could me helpful for those who do not feel comfortable with the effect
body:
No Nausea – Features:

Completely removes the nausea effect in Minecraft using the /effect command.

Keeps your screen stable during potion effects, mobs attacks, or custom map events.

Perfect for players who are sensitive to motion sickness or want a smoother visual experience.

Lightweight and simple—no complicated setup or extra mods required.

Compatible with survival, adventure maps, and creative gameplay.

Helps maintain immersion without annoying screen distortions.
